title: AgentProofBench: Benchmarking Reusable Verifiers for Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34634v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reusable Web-agent verification requires a rule to follow changing requirements and support subsequent execution. We introduce AgentProofBench, which connects paired tests of a frozen acceptance rule to execution from identical saved openings. The resource spans 97 tasks, 79 families, and four Web services. Experiments with DeepSeek Flash/Pro establish two linked measurements. Across 48 families, complete-panel and decision-replay tests retain 82/96 Flash and 79/96 Pro source programs; paired reuse-rebuild BA intervals are [-5.47, 1.57] and [-10.16, 0.00] percentage points. Across 22 execution families, deployment-state panel correctness separates program assignments whose two saved openings are both delivered correctly: 32/33 assignments with error-free panels, versus 1/11 with panel errors. translated_title: AgentProofBench：面向Web智能体的可复用验证器基准测试
translated_abstract: 可复用的Web智能体验证需要一个能够跟随变化需求并支持后续执行的规则。我们提出了AgentProofBench，它将冻结验收规则的成对测试与来自相同保存起点的执行连接起来。该资源涵盖97个任务、79个任务族和四个Web服务。使用DeepSeek Flash/Pro的实验建立了两项关联测量。在48个任务族中，完整面板测试和决策回放测试分别保留了82/96个Flash和79/96个Pro源程序；成对的复用-重建BA区间分别为[-5.47, 1.57]和[-10.16, 0.00]个百分点。在22个执行任务族中，部署状态面板正确性能够有效区分两个保存起点均被正确交付的程序分配：33个无错误面板的分配中有32个成功交付，而11个存在面板错误的分配中仅有1个成功交付。所有参考定义的程序门控回归和扣留交付均发生在后一组中。中性延续获得了最高的正确性。
tldr: AgentProofBench是一个评估Web智能体可复用验证器的基准，涵盖97个任务和四个Web服务，实验表明部署状态面板正确性可以有效区分正确交付与错误交付的程序分配。
en_tdlr: AgentProofBench is a benchmark for evaluating reusable Web-agent verifiers spanning 97 tasks and four Web services, demonstrating that deployment-state panel correctness effectively separates program assignments with correct deliveries from those with errors.
